paper.title: Quantum Geometric Tensor Preconditioning for Stable Training of Recurrent Neural Quantum States
paper.authors: Adil Attar, Amine M. Aboussalah, Mohamed Hibat-Allah

results.system_description: Transverse-field Ising, 200 sites · h/J = 1 · open. H = -J sum_<ij> sigma^z_i sigma^z_j - h sum_i sigma^x_i; Pauli matrices; J = 1; h = 1; no constant shift
results.source_location: Table "Final variational energy results" (tab:energies), row "1D TFIM", column E_minSR/N
results.eligibility_evidence: Final variational energy per site of the trained positive RNN, with the Monte Carlo error in parentheses; the reference column is the exact solution.
results.notes: H = -J sum_{i=1}^{N-1} sigma^z_i sigma^z_{i+1} - h sum_i sigma^x_i with Pauli matrices, open chain of N = 200 spins, J = h = 1 (Sec. 1D Transverse-Field Ising Model, Fig. 2 caption). GRU cells with d_h = 32 hidden units and 100 samples per step (hyperparameter table).
